item.title: Self-Hosted SOC Case Management: TheHive vs Cortex vs IRIS
item.description: When a security incident strikes — a compromised endpoint, a suspicious login pattern, or a confirmed data breach — your SOC team needs more than just alerts. They need a structured way to track investigations, coordinate analysis, assign tasks, and document every step of the response. That’s what a SOC case management platform provides.
